scripts.dev: pnpm run generate && pnpm --filter @share-file/ui run dev
scripts.check:python: pnpm exec node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/check-python-syntax.py packages/cli scripts tests/contract
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ui && pnpm run lint:root
scripts.test:contract: pnpm exec node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests/contract
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:contract
scripts.generate: pnpm run generate-info && pnpm run generate-share-file && pnpm run generate-manifest
scripts.generate-info: pnpm exec node scripts/run-python.mjs packages/cli/generate-info.py public
scripts.generate-share-file: pnpm exec node scripts/run-python.mjs packages/cli/generate-share-file.py public public/assets/data/share-file.json
scripts.generate-manifest: pnpm exec node scripts/run-python.mjs packages/cli/generate-files-manifest.py public/assets/data public/assets/data/files.jsonl
